skus.title: NOVA Adjustable Drawer Divider, White
skus.item_highlights: Adjustable fit; tool-free setup; office drawer organization
bullets: ADJUSTABLE FIT: Helps separate everyday office supplies in compatible drawers.
DRAWER SECTIONS: Group small items by the way you use them.
OFFICE ROUTINE: Keep stationery in its designated section.
WHITE FINISH: A light color for the inside of the drawer.
FIT CHECK: Compare the divider with the inside of your drawer before use.
skus.description: Divide a compatible office drawer into sections for everyday supplies. Choose a layout that groups items by use and check the available inside space before positioning the divider.
skus.search_terms: desk drawer organizer adjustable divider office storage
